programs.title: Secrets of the wrecks of the Baltic Sea
programs.desc: One German ship sunk, several damaged - this was the effect of the Polish fleet in September 1939.The losses are the result of an erroneous strategy of the staff of Commander Aleksander Mohuczy, commander of the submarine division.As a result, crews had to fight for their own survival instead of focusing on destroying enemy forces.The episode is devoted to the faulty tactical plan of the Polish Navy and the story of the only success of Polish ships during the September Campaign - the installation of minefields by ORP Żbik to protect the coast, on which the enemy minesweeper M-85 sank, losing 24 of the 51 crew members.For almost 74 years, the location of the wreck was unknown.

programs.title: Secrets of the wrecks of the Baltic Sea
programs.desc: A team of divers is combing the bottom of the Baltic Sea in search of sunken ships.Witnesses of the events, historians and documentarians discover their history and look for answers to troubling questions.
